curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can an experienced detective and profiler decode the twisted rules of a childhood game before the killer claims the final letter?
curatedMovie.description: Directed by Johnny Martin, this crime thriller follows a homicide detective who joins forces with a criminal profiler to track a serial killer staging gruesome murders patterned after the children's game Hangman.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A somber, suspenseful procedural best suited for focused solo viewing, balancing steady pace with grim mystery.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Anchored by a grim cat-and-mouse dynamic, it delivers a classic procedural hunt where every cryptic clue raises the investigative stakes.
